selected.rationale: The Wellness Optimizer tracks supplements and seeks evidence-backed products, perfectly aligning with the advertiser's workout supplement offerings. They can be effectively reached on Daily Form, which features a science-forward wellness audience.

The Value-Conscious Shopper focuses on clear value articulation and comparison shopping, which directly matches the advertiser's budget-friendly positioning of offering the same formulations as expensive brands for half the cost. They shop on Pantrygood, where they look for high-value essentials.

The Fitness Enthusiast actively works out and buys performance supplements, aligning directly with the advertiser's core category of pre-workout, creatine, and protein. They will be reached on Studiogrid, which hosts users actively booking fitness classes and personal training.

rejected.reason: The Busy Parent prioritizes household and convenience products and loves subscriptions, whereas the advertiser operates on a one-off business model for workout supplements.
The Gen Z Aesthete focuses on beauty, fashion, and visual branding, which misaligns with the advertiser's functional, price-competitive workout supplement product line.
The Pet Parent focuses entirely on pet health and pet supplies, which has no relevance to human workout supplements.
The Affluent Classic prefers classic apparel, home goods, and luxury positioning with high AOVs, whereas the advertiser competes strictly on a budget-tier, half-the-cost pricing strategy.
The Sustainability Buyer focuses on environmental footprints, supply chains, and green certifications, whereas the advertiser's primary competitive advantage is price rather than ecological claims.
The Convenience-First Millennial relies heavily on instant delivery and subscription services, whereas the advertiser utilizes a one-off purchase business model.
The Gifter looks for premium presentation and gift-wrap messaging for holidays and life events, which conflicts with the functional, everyday utility of budget workout supplements.
